entities.name: Reactant 1 scaffold
observations: Contains a free aniline NH2, while the piperidine nitrogen is Boc-protected.
The chloropyrimidine substituent is retained under the proposed transformation.

entities.name: 2,5-Difluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride
observations: Acts as the sulfonylating electrophile at sulfur.

entities.name: Pyridine
observations: Likely serves as base or HCl scavenger and is not incorporated into the product.

entities.name: Aniline sulfonylation
observations: The free aniline nitrogen attacks the sulfonyl chloride sulfur, chloride leaves, and an arylsulfonamide is formed.
The Boc group and chloropyrimidine substituent are expected to remain intact.

entities.name: Proposed sulfonamide product
observations: The product contains an Ar-NH-S(=O)2-(2,5-difluorophenyl) linkage.
A related furan sulfonyl chloride database record is a positional/structural mismatch and should not be used for exact reagent matching.
